class.name: RailVehicleController
class.description: What [VehicleController] says of every vehicle, plus the railway's own: its cabs, couplers and trainset, the master controller and reverser, the relays, the low voltage, the battery and the converter, and the stepping [RailVehicleServer] runs it by. Railway components ([RailVehicleComponent]) belong to one of these.

method.name: antislip
method.description: The anti-slip brake pressed ([code]antislip[/code], [code]AntiSlippingButton()[/code]).

method.name: cab_activation
method.description: The cab switched on ([code]CabActivisation()[/code]) or off ([code]CabDeactivisation()[/code]) as [param enabled] says; the lighting takes the cab's preset ([code]Train.cpp:3101-3104, 3134-3137[/code]).

method.name: cab_activation_auto
method.description: The cab switched on by itself, when the FIZ lets it ([code]CabActivisationAuto()[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:2672[/code]).

method.name: cab_controls_reset
method.description: The controls a cab change leaves at rest - the brake handle at its neutral, the controllers at zero ([code]TMoverParameters::ChangeCab()[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:735-749[/code]).

method.name: cab_deactivation_auto
method.description: The cab switched off as the vehicle switches it off by itself when the FIZ lets it ([code]CabDeactivisationAuto()[/code], [code]Train.cpp:10336[/code]).

method.name: cabin_enter
method.description: A driver came over from another vehicle through a gangway: the cab switched on. Command [code]cabin_enter[/code], sent by [method RailVehicleServer.person_change_cabin].

method.name: cabin_leave
method.description: Its driver went over to another vehicle through a gangway: the cab switched off, the brake handle at its neutral, the controllers at zero. Command [code]cabin_leave[/code], sent by [method RailVehicleServer.person_change_cabin].

method.name: compartment_lights
method.description: The passengers' compartment lights switched on or off ([code]CompartmentLightsSwitch()[/code]).

method.name: compartment_lights_switch_off
method.description: The compartment lights' "off" switch pressed or let go ([code]CompartmentLightsSwitchOff()[/code]).

method.name: compute_fast_movement
method.description: The quick integration of one physics step of [param delta] seconds on the track last handed down ([code]FastComputeMovement()[/code]); a vehicle whose physics is switched off is not moved at all.

method.name: compute_forces
method.description: The forces of one physics step of [param delta] seconds ([code]ComputeTotalForce()[/code]).

method.name: compute_movement
method.description: The full integration of one physics step of [param delta] seconds on the track last handed down ([code]ComputeMovement()[/code]); a vehicle whose physics is switched off is not moved at all.

method.name: couple
method.description: Couples [param end] of this vehicle to [param other_end] of [param other] by [param coupling] ([code]TMoverParameters::Attach()[/code]); both vehicles announce [signal trainset_changed].

method.name: coupler_adapter_attach
method.description: The adapter of the vehicle nearest beyond an end (its [member coupler_adapter_model], length and height) fitted to that end, as long as it stands within reach and leaves room for it (attach_coupler_adapter(), DynObj.cpp:1754-1789); [param where] as [method coupler_connect]'s. Command [code]coupler_adapter_attach[/code].

method.name: coupler_adapter_fit
method.description: The adapter of the vehicle coupled at an end fitted to it whatever the room - a trainset the scenery couples (AttachNext(), DynObj.cpp:2740-2758).

method.name: coupler_adapter_remove
method.description: The adapter taken off an end, which is uncoupled first (remove_coupler_adapter(), DynObj.cpp:1791-1810). Command [code]coupler_adapter_remove[/code].

method.name: coupler_connect
method.description: Joins one more coupling to the neighbour at an end - the coupler first, then the hoses, the control line, the gangway and the heating, what both couplers allow. [param where] is the end ([enum CouplerEnd]), or a world position the nearer end is taken by.

method.name: coupler_disconnect
method.description: Uncouples an end, unless it is a permanent coupling or cannot be undone now ([code]DettachStatus()[/code]); [param where] as [method coupler_connect]'s.

method.name: direction_decrease
method.description: Increase direction by one step

method.name: direction_increase
method.description: Decrease direction by one step

method.name: find_rail_components
method.description: Every railway component of [param type] - a vehicle has two couplers, one per end.

method.name: get_compartment_lights_active
method.description: Whether the compartment lights are lit ([code]CompartmentLights.is_active[/code]).

method.name: get_compartment_lights_enabled
method.description: Whether the compartment lights are switched on ([code]CompartmentLights.is_enabled[/code]).

method.name: get_coupled_controller
method.description: The vehicle coupled at [param end]; null when none is.

method.name: get_coupled_end
method.description: The end of the vehicle coupled at [param end] facing this one ([code]TCoupling::ConnectedNr[/code]); only while [method is_coupled].

method.name: get_coupler_adapter_fitted_height
method.description: The height over the rail of the adapter fitted to an end [m].

method.name: get_coupler_adapter_fitted_length
method.description: The length the adapter fitted to an end adds to it [m].

method.name: get_coupler_adapter_fitted_model
method.description: The model of the adapter fitted to an end, empty without one.

method.name: get_coupler_joinable_flags
method.description: The couplings this end and the neighbour beyond it can join: what both couplers allow, the control line only between equal control types; [constant COUPLING_FLAG_NONE] without a neighbour.

method.name: get_coupler_stretched
method.description: Whether a coupler is pulled past its strength ([code]stretch_duration > 0[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:5405[/code]).

method.name: get_derail_cause
method.description: Why the vehicle left the rails; [constant DERAIL_CAUSE_NONE] while it is on them ([code]DerailReason[/code]).

method.name: get_direction_absolute
method.description: The vehicle's own direction: the reverser times the active cab ([code]DirAbsolute[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:669[/code]).

method.name: get_mass_reduced
method.description: The rotating masses' share of the vehicle's mass [kg] ([code]Mred[/code]) - as the simulation holds it, which the wheels may have derived from their own inertia.

method.name: get_rail_component
method.description: The railway component of [param type], or null when this vehicle has none.

method.name: get_track_friction
method.description: The rails' friction the wheels have now: the track's, times the scenery's ([member SimulationServer.friction]) and the weather's ([method SimulationServer.simulation_get_weather_friction_factor]) ([code]tp.friction[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:3176[/code]).

method.name: get_train_damage
method.description: The vehicle's damage, as the original's bits ([code]DamageFlag[/code], [code]dtrain_*[/code], [code]MOVER.h:125-136[/code]) - [code]128[/code] is derailed.

method.name: ground_relay_reset
method.description: The main circuit's ground relay reset ([code]maincircuitgroundreset[/code], [code]RelayReset()[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:6653[/code]).

method.name: is_coupled
method.description: Whether a vehicle is coupled at [param end].

method.name: is_coupled_by
method.description: Whether [param end] is joined by every one of [param flags] ([code]TestFlag(Couplers[end].CouplingFlag, ...)[/code]).

method.name: is_coupler_automatic
method.description: Whether an end couples as an automatic coupler, its adapter's or its own (TCoupling::type()).

method.name: main_controller_decrease
method.description: Decrease main controller position

method.name: main_controller_increase
method.description: Increase main controller position

method.name: main_controller_set_position
method.description: Put the main controller at [param position] at once, without stepping through the positions between - as the original's driver sets an EIM controller. A step restarts the controller's relay time, which an Elf's integrated control waits out before it raises the power.

method.name: opposite_end
method.description: The other end of the same vehicle.

method.name: process_movement
method.description: The distance [m] the vehicle's own simulation moves it in [param delta] seconds, along its front.

method.name: second_controller_decrease
method.description: The second (shunt) controller [param step] positions back ([code]DecScndCtrl()[/code]).

method.name: second_controller_increase
method.description: The second (shunt) controller [param step] positions on ([code]IncScndCtrl()[/code]).

method.name: uncouple
method.description: Undoes every coupling at [param end] ([code]Dettach()[/code]); both vehicles announce [signal trainset_changed].

method.name: update_location
method.description: Hands the simulation the vehicle's place in the world, where it has moved ([code]Loc[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:2334[/code]).

members.member: [code]Cntrl.InactiveCabFlag[/code] Bitmask of automatic actions performed on cab deactivation/activation.
[code]coupleradapter:[/code] - the height over the rail of the adapter this vehicle hands a neighbour of another coupler type [m]; the original's own without the key (DynObj.cpp:1765-1769).
[code]coupleradapter:[/code] - the length the adapter this vehicle hands a neighbour adds to its end [m].
[code]coupleradapter:[/code] - the model of that adapter, under [code]models/[/code].
[code]Param.HeatingP[/code] Power drawn for heating, in kW.
[code]Param.LightP[/code] Power drawn for lighting, in kW.
How much the vehicle carries when the scenery places it ([code]loadcount[/code] of a [code]dynamic[/code]).

What the vehicle carries when the scenery places it ([code]loadtype[/code] of a [code]dynamic[/code]). The simulation reads more than cargo out of it: [code]pantstate[/code] is how scenery starts a locomotive with its pantographs already up.
[code]Param.Mred[/code] Reduced (rotating) mass, added to [member mass] for braking calculations.

[code]Param.Type[/code] Bitmask identifying a vehicle's special-cased behavior family (e.g. EZT, ET22, ET40, ET42, EP05, DMU). Not every value listed on the FIZ wiki is implemented by the simulation - only the ones it knows are exposed here (notably, [code]182[/code] is missing).
The name of the vehicle's type - the original's CHK/MMD name [code]TMoverParameters[/code] keeps as [code]TypeName[/code] ([code]DynObj.cpp:2019[/code]).

signal.name: coupler_adapter_attached
signal.description: A coupler adapter was fitted to [param end].

signal.name: coupler_adapter_removed
signal.description: A coupler adapter was taken off [param end].

signal.name: coupler_attached
signal.description: One coupling [param flag] was joined, once per event.

signal.name: coupler_detached
signal.description: One coupling [param flag] was undone, once per event.

signal.name: derailed
signal.description: The vehicle left the rails, for [param cause]; emitted once ([code]dtrain_out[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:5207-5214[/code]).

signal.name: trainset_changed
signal.description: The trainset this vehicle belongs to gained or lost a vehicle.
